-
-msgid "Cube 算子开发"
-msgstr "Cube operator development"
-
-msgid ""
-"Cube 算子以矩阵乘或批量矩阵乘为主要计算负载，Triton 代码中通常以 `tl.dot` 为核心。Cube 算子的关键是围绕 M/N/K "
-"三个维度设计 tile，使 A/B tile 能高效搬运到片上并在 Cube Core 上完成累加。"
-msgstr ""
-"The Cube operator primarily uses matrix multiplication or batched matrix "
-"multiplication as its main computational workload, with `tl.dot` typically "
-"at the core of Triton code. The key to the Cube operator is designing tiles "
-"around the M/N/K dimensions so that A/B tiles can be efficiently moved on-"
-"chip and accumulated on the Cube Core."
-
-msgid "Cube 简单算子开发"
-msgstr "Cube Simple Operator Development"
-
-msgid ""
-"简单 Cube 算子可参考本仓 "
-"[矩阵乘法样例](../examples/05_matrix_multiplication_example.md)。一个最小开发路径包括："
-msgstr ""
-"For a simple Cube operator, refer to the [matrix multiplication "
-"example](../examples/05_matrix_multiplication_example.md) in this "
-"repository. A minimal development path includes:"
-
-msgid "明确输入输出 shape 和 stride，例如 `A[M, K]`、`B[K, N]`、`C[M, N]`。"
-msgstr ""
-"Clearly define the input and output shapes and strides, for example, `A[M, "
-"K]`, `B[K, N]`, `C[M, N]`."
-
-msgid "用 `tl.program_id` 映射当前 program 到输出矩阵的 `(pid_m, pid_n)` tile。"
-msgstr ""
-"Map the current program to the `(pid_m, pid_n)` tile of the output matrix "
-"using `tl.program_id`."
-
-msgid "用 `BLOCK_SIZE_M/N/K` 构造 A/B 的二维偏移。"
-msgstr "Construct the 2D offsets for A/B using `BLOCK_SIZE_M/N/K`."
-
-msgid "沿 K 维循环加载 A/B 子块，并用 `tl.dot` 累加到 fp32 accumulator。"
-msgstr ""
-"Load A/B sub-blocks cyclically along the K dimension and accumulate them "
-"into the fp32 accumulator using `tl.dot`."
-
-msgid "将 accumulator 转为输出 dtype，并用边界 mask 写回 C。"
-msgstr ""
-"Cast the accumulator to the output dtype and write back to C using the "
-"boundary mask."
-
-msgid "核心结构如下："
-msgstr "The core structure is as follows:"
-
-msgid ""
-"@triton.jit\n"
-"def matmul_kernel(a_ptr, b_ptr, c_ptr,\n"
-"                  M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  stride_am: tl.constexpr, stride_ak: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  stride_bk: tl.constexpr, stride_bn: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  stride_cm: tl.constexpr, stride_cn: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr):\n"
-"    pid = tl.program_id(0)\n"
-"    num_pid_n = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N)\n"
-"    pid_m = pid // num_pid_n\n"
-"    pid_n = pid % num_pid_n\n"
-"\n"
-"    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)\n"
-"    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)\n"
-"    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)\n"
-"    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N), dtype=tl.float32)\n"
-"\n"
-"    for k0 in range(0, K, BLOCK_K):\n"
-"        a = tl.load(a_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_am + (k0 + offs_k)[None, :] * stride_ak,\n"
-"                    mask=(offs_m[:, None] < M) & ((k0 + offs_k)[None, :] < K), other=0.0)\n"
-"        b = tl.load(b_ptr + (k0 + offs_k)[:, None] * stride_bk + offs_n[None, :] * stride_bn,\n"
-"                    mask=((k0 + offs_k)[:, None] < K) & (offs_n[None, :] < N), other=0.0)\n"
-"        acc = tl.dot(a, b, acc)\n"
-"\n"
-"    tl.store(c_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_cm + offs_n[None, :] * stride_cn,\n"
-"             acc, mask=(offs_m[:, None] < M) & (offs_n[None, :] < N))\n"
-msgstr ""
-"@triton.jit\n"
-"def matmul_kernel(a_ptr, b_ptr, c_ptr,\n"
-"                  M: tl.constexpr, N: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  stride_am: tl.constexpr, stride_ak: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  stride_bk: tl.constexpr, stride_bn: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  stride_cm: tl.constexpr, stride_cn: tl.constexpr,\n"
-"                  BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr):\n"
-"    pid = tl.program_id(0)\n"
-"    num_pid_n = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N)\n"
-"    pid_m = pid // num_pid_n\n"
-"    pid_n = pid % num_pid_n\n"
-"\n"
-"    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)\n"
-"    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)\n"
-"    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)\n"
-"    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N), dtype=tl.float32)\n"
-"\n"
-"    for k0 in range(0, K, BLOCK_K):\n"
-"        a = tl.load(a_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_am + (k0 + offs_k)[None, :] * stride_ak,\n"
-"                    mask=(offs_m[:, None] < M) & ((k0 + offs_k)[None, :] < K), other=0.0)\n"
-"        b = tl.load(b_ptr + (k0 + offs_k)[:, None] * stride_bk + offs_n[None, :] * stride_bn,\n"
-"                    mask=((k0 + offs_k)[:, None] < K) & (offs_n[None, :] < N), other=0.0)\n"
-"        acc = tl.dot(a, b, acc)\n"
-"\n"
-"    tl.store(c_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_cm + offs_n[None, :] * stride_cn,\n"
-"             acc, mask=(offs_m[:, None] < M) & (offs_n[None, :] < N))\n"
-
-msgid "简单 Cube 算子调参时优先关注："
-msgstr ""
-"When tuning parameters for a simple Cube operator, prioritize attention to:"
-
-msgid "`BLOCK_M/N/K` 是否满足硬件支持和 UB/L1 容量限制。"
-msgstr ""
-"Whether `BLOCK_M/N/K` satisfies hardware support and UB/L1 capacity "
-"constraints."
-
-msgid "K 维循环是否可以开启 `multibuffer` 以形成搬运和计算流水。"
-msgstr ""
-"Can the K-dimension loop enable `multibuffer` to form a pipeline of data "
-"movement and computation?"
-
-msgid ""
-"输出 tile 是否包含额外 bias、scale、activation。如果后处理很轻，可以仍归为 Cube 算子；如果后处理包含明显 Vector "
-"归约或跨核同步，应按 CV 融合算子组织。"
-msgstr ""
-"Output tile whether it contains extra bias, scale, activation. If the post-"
-"processing is lightweight, it can still be classified as a Cube operator; if"
-" the post-processing includes significant Vector reduction or cross-core "
-"synchronization, it should be organized as a CV fusion operator."
-
-msgid "Cube 复杂算子开发"
-msgstr "Developing complex operators for Cube."
-
-msgid ""
-"复杂 Cube 场景通常来自 attention、batched matmul、grouped matmul 或形状不规则的矩阵乘。当前 "
-"[Ascend/triton-ascend-ops](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops) "
-"主分支的复杂案例集中在 `tutorial/best_practice/`，其中 "
-"[`002-decode_grouped_attention.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py) 可以作为复杂"
-" Cube 核心逻辑的参考：它包含 QK、PV 两段 `tl.dot`，并展示了 KV cache 离散索引下如何重组 K/V 访存。"
-msgstr ""
-"Complex Cube scenarios typically arise from attention, batched matmul, "
-"grouped matmul, or matrix multiplication with irregular shapes. The complex "
-"cases in the current [Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops) main branch are "
-"concentrated in `tutorial/best_practice/`, where "
-"[`002-decode_grouped_attention.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py) can "
-"serve as a reference for the core logic of complex Cube operations: it "
-"includes two `tl.dot` segments, QK and PV, and demonstrates how to "
-"reorganize K/V memory access under discrete KV cache indexing."
-
-msgid "复杂 Cube 算子建议按以下顺序拆解："
-msgstr ""
-"For complex Cube operators, it is recommended to decompose them in the "
-"following order:"
-
-msgid ""
-"**先抽出纯矩阵乘核心**：确认每次 `tl.dot` 的输入 tile shape、dtype、累加 dtype 和输出 tile shape。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Extract the pure matrix multiplication core first**: Confirm the input "
-"tile shape, dtype, accumulation dtype, and output tile shape for each "
-"`tl.dot`."
-
-msgid ""
-"**再处理不规则访存**：如果 K/V cache 低维离散、高维连续，直接二维 load 可能退化为标量访存。可先按连续维搬入 UB，再通过转置或 "
-"Ascend 扩展接口 `extension.insert_slice` 重组为 `tl.dot` 需要的布局。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Re-handling irregular memory access**: If the K/V cache has low-"
-"dimensional discreteness and high-dimensional continuity, direct 2D load may"
-" degrade into scalar memory access. You can first move data into the UB "
-"along the continuous dimension, then reorganize it into the layout required "
-"by `tl.dot` through transpose or the Ascend extension interface "
-"`extension.insert_slice`."
-
-msgid ""
-"**把归约和归一化留到边界明确的位置**：例如 attention 中的 `max/sum/exp` 属于 Vector 逻辑，若和 `tl.dot` "
-"放在同一 kernel，需要转到 [CV 融合算子开发](./cv_fusion_operator.md) 的思路。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Defer reduction and normalization to well-defined boundaries**: For "
-"example, `max/sum/exp` in attention belongs to Vector logic. If placed in "
-"the same kernel as `tl.dot`, it requires shifting to the approach of [CV "
-"Fusion Operator Development](./cv_fusion_operator.md)."
-
-msgid ""
-"**为长 K 或长序列设计内层循环**：K 维循环要控制单次 A/B tile 的片上占用；序列维循环要避免一次 load 过大的 K/V block。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Designing Inner Loops for Long K or Long Sequences**: The K-dimensional "
-"loop must control the on-chip occupancy of a single A/B tile; the sequence-"
-"dimensional loop must avoid loading excessively large K/V blocks at once."
-
-msgid ""
-"**用 Autotune 管理候选 tile**：为常见 shape 准备多组 `BLOCK_M/N/K` 和 `multibuffer` "
-"配置，让运行时选择最优组合。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Use Autotune to manage candidate tiles**: Prepare multiple sets of "
-"`BLOCK_M/N/K` and `multibuffer` configurations for common shapes, allowing "
-"the runtime to select the optimal combination."
-
-msgid ""
-"复杂 Cube 算子的常见风险是把 GPU 上的大量 program 直接迁移到 NPU。对于逻辑核相互独立且通过 IR 安全分析的 "
-"kernel，后端会自动把逻辑 grid 映射到可用物理核；不适用的 kernel 会被自动跳过。如果 kernel "
-"存在顺序依赖或未通过安全分析，应让每个 program 通过内层循环处理多个 tile。"
-msgstr ""
-"A common risk with complex Cube operators is directly migrating a large "
-"number of programs from the GPU to the NPU. For kernels with independent "
-"logical cores that pass IR safety analysis, the backend automatically maps "
-"the logical grid to available physical cores; it automatically skips "
-"unsuitable kernels. If a kernel has sequential dependencies or fails the "
-"safety analysis, use an inner loop for each program to process multiple "
-"tiles."
-
-msgid ""
-"复杂 Cube 场景通常来自 attention、batched matmul、grouped matmul 或形状不规则的矩阵乘。当前 "
-"[`Ascend/triton-ascend-ops`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops) "
-"主分支的复杂案例集中在 `tutorial/best_practice/`，其中 "
-"[`002-decode_grouped_attention.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py) 可以作为复杂"
-" Cube 核心逻辑的参考：它包含 QK、PV 两段 `tl.dot`，并展示了 KV cache 离散索引下如何重组 K/V 访存。"
-msgstr ""
-"Complex Cube scenarios typically arise from attention, batched matmul, "
-"grouped matmul, or matrix multiplications with irregular shapes. The complex"
-" cases on the main branch of [`Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops) are concentrated in "
-"`tutorial/best_practice/`, among which "
-"[`002-decode_grouped_attention.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py) can "

-" under discrete KV cache indices."

-msgstr ""

-
-msgid "CV 融合算子开发"
-msgstr "Development of CV Fusion Operator"
-
-msgid ""
-"CV 融合算子指同一个算子中同时使用 Cube Core 和 Vector Core：Cube Core 通常负责 "
-"`tl.dot`、矩阵乘或卷积式主计算，Vector Core 负责 bias、activation、softmax、归约、mask、layout "
-"重排或跨块同步。CV 融合的目标是减少 kernel 边界和 GM 往返，但需要同时控制 Cube tile、Vector tile、UB/L1 "
-"占用和同步关系。"
-msgstr ""
-"CV fusion operator refers to the simultaneous use of Cube Core and Vector "
-"Core within the same operator: Cube Core is typically responsible for "
-"`tl.dot`, matrix multiplication, or convolution-style main computation, "
-"while Vector Core handles bias, activation, softmax, reduction, mask, layout"
-" rearrangement, or cross-block synchronization. The goal of CV fusion is to "
-"reduce kernel boundaries and GM round trips, but it requires simultaneously "
-"controlling Cube tile, Vector tile, UB/L1 occupancy, and synchronization "
-"relationships."
-
-msgid "CV 融合简单算子开发"
-msgstr "Development of a Simple CV Fusion Operator"
-
-msgid ""
-"简单 CV 融合建议先从本仓 [矩阵乘法样例](../examples/05_matrix_multiplication_example.md) "
-"抽出稳定的 `tl.dot` 主计算，再在写回前加入 Vector 后处理；更复杂的切片更新可参考 "
-"[融合注意力样例](../examples/04_fused_attention_example.md)。最小路径如下："
-msgstr ""
-"For simple CV fusion, it is recommended to first extract the stable `tl.dot`"
-" main computation from the [matrix multiplication "
-"example](../examples/05_matrix_multiplication_example.md) in this "
-"repository, and then add Vector post-processing before writing back; for "
-"more complex slice updates, refer to the [fused attention "
-"example](../examples/04_fused_attention_example.md). The minimal path is as "
-"follows:"
-
-msgid "先实现稳定的 Cube 主计算，例如 `acc = tl.dot(a, b, acc)`。"
-msgstr ""
-"First implement the stable Cube main computation, for example `acc = "
-"tl.dot(a, b, acc)`."
-
-msgid ""
-"在 accumulator 写回前融合轻量 Vector 后处理，例如 bias、scale、activation 或 dtype cast。"
-msgstr ""
-"Fuse lightweight Vector post-processing before accumulator write-back, such "
-"as bias, scale, activation, or dtype cast."
-
-msgid ""
-"对较大的 accumulator，可使用 `range` 配合 "
-"`extension.extract_slice`/`extension.insert_slice` 做普通子块切分，避免 Vector 后处理阶段 "
-"UB overflow。"
-msgstr ""
-"For larger accumulators, you can use `range` combined with "
-"`extension.extract_slice`/`extension.insert_slice` to perform ordinary sub-"
-"block slicing, avoiding UB overflow in the Vector post-processing stage."
-
-msgid ""
-"`extension.parallel(..., bind_sub_block=True)` 属于更强的显式多 Vector "
-"子块绑定路径，目标硬件和编译配置存在差异时可能不可用，不建议作为简单示例的默认写法。"
-msgstr ""
-"`extension.parallel(..., bind_sub_block=True)` belongs to a stronger "
-"explicit multi-Vector sub-block binding path. It may not be available when "
-"the target hardware and compilation configurations differ, so it is not "
-"recommended as the default writing style for simple examples."
-
-msgid "示例结构："
-msgstr "Example structure:"
-
-msgid ""
-"简单 CV 融合开发时要保持边界清晰：Cube 负责产生较大的二维 accumulator，Vector 负责同一 tile 内的逐元素或小规模归约。若"
-" Vector 部分需要跨多个 Cube tile 共享状态，就需要引入同步、workspace 或拆分 kernel。"
-msgstr ""
-"Keep boundaries clear during simple CV fusion development: Cube is "
-"responsible for producing larger two-dimensional accumulators, while Vector "
-"handles element-wise or small-scale reductions within the same tile. If the "
-"Vector portion needs to share state across multiple Cube tiles, "
-"synchronization, workspace, or kernel splitting must be introduced."
-
-msgid "CV 融合复杂算子开发"
-msgstr "Development of Complex Operators for CV Fusion"
-
-msgid ""
-"复杂 CV 融合可参考 [Ascend/triton-ascend-ops](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-ops) 中的 best practice："
-msgstr ""
-"For complex CV fusion, refer to the best practice in [Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops)."
-
-msgid ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py)：Decode"
-" attention 中 QK/PV 使用 Cube，softmax、mask、指数、归一化和离散 KV 访存重排使用 Vector。"
-msgstr ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/002-decode_grouped_attention.py): In "
-"Decode attention, QK/PV uses Cube, while softmax, mask, exponent, "
-"normalization, and discrete KV memory access rearrangement use Vector."
-
-msgid ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/003-fused-cat-slice-"
-"conv1d.zh.md`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/003-fused-cat-slice-conv1d.zh.md)：展示融合 "
-"cat、slice、conv1d update 时如何用 `extension.insert_slice`、转置和分核优化减少离散访存与 padding"
-" 开销。"
-msgstr ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/003-fused-cat-slice-"
-"conv1d.zh.md`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/003-fused-cat-slice-conv1d.zh.md): "
-"Demonstrates how to use `extension.insert_slice`, transposition, and kernel "
-"splitting optimization to reduce scattered memory access and padding "
-"overhead when fusing cat, slice, and conv1d update operations."
-
-msgid "复杂 CV 融合建议按数据流分层组织："
-msgstr ""
-"Complex CV fusion is recommended to be organized in layers according to the "
-"data flow:"
-
-msgid "**主计算层**：识别哪些步骤必须走 Cube，例如 QK、PV、GEMM、batched matmul。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Main Computation Layer**: Identifies which steps must go through the Cube,"
-" such as QK, PV, GEMM, and batched matmul."
-
-msgid ""
-"**Vector 后处理层**：识别 "
-"softmax、activation、mask、scale、normalization、cat/slice、layout transform "
-"等是否能在同一 tile 内完成。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Vector Post-processing Layer**: Identify whether operations such as "
-"softmax, activation, mask, scale, normalization, cat/slice, and layout "
-"transform can be completed within the same tile."
-
-msgid ""
-"**访存重排层**：对离散 KV cache、MoE token 重排、短尾轴（最后一个维度） tensor，优先在 UB 中用 "
-"`extension.insert_slice`、`extension.extract_slice`、转置或借轴转置形成硬件友好的连续访问。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Memory Access Reordering Layer**: For discrete KV cache, MoE token "
-"reordering, and short-tail axis (last dimension) tensors, prioritize using "
-"`extension.insert_slice`, `extension.extract_slice`, transpose, or axis-"
-"borrowing transpose in the UB to form hardware-friendly contiguous access."
-
-msgid ""
-"**流水和同步层**：通过 "
-"`multibuffer`、`set_workspace_multibuffer`、`tile_mix_vector_loop`、`tile_mix_cube_loop`"
-" 等编译选项探索 Cube 与 Vector 的重叠执行。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Pipeline and Synchronization Layer**: Explore the overlapping execution of"
-" Cube and Vector through compilation options such as `multibuffer`, "
-"`set_workspace_multibuffer`, `tile_mix_vector_loop`, and "
-"`tile_mix_cube_loop`."
-
-msgid ""
-"**分核层**：CV 融合算子通常按 Cube Core 数量发射 grid；运行时会以约 1:2 的比例协同 Vector Core。不要简单沿用 "
-"GPU 上的大 grid。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Core Distribution Layer**: CV fusion operators typically launch grids "
-"based on the number of Cube Cores; the runtime coordinates Vector Cores at a"
-" ratio of approximately 1:2. Do not simply reuse the large grid sizes from "
-"GPU."
-
-msgid "对于 attention 类 CV 融合，推荐先让非 causal、短序列、小 head_dim 的 case 跑通，再逐步加入："
-msgstr ""
-"For attention-based CV fusion, it is recommended to first get the non-"
-"causal, short-sequence, small head_dim cases working, then gradually add:"
-
-msgid "causal mask 分阶段处理。"
-msgstr "Causal mask is processed in stages."
-
-msgid "长序列 K/V block 循环。"
-msgstr "Long-sequence K/V block loop."
-
-msgid "`m_i`/`l_i` 的数值稳定 softmax 更新。"
-msgstr "Numerically stable softmax update for `m_i`/`l_i`."
-
-msgid "HEAD_DIM 较大时的 accumulator workspace 和子块切分。"
-msgstr ""
-"Accumulator workspace and sub-block partitioning when HEAD_DIM is large."
-
-msgid "KV cache 离散索引下的 load 重排。"
-msgstr "Load reordering under discrete indexing of KV cache."
-
-msgid ""
-"复杂 CV 融合调优时，优先观察 profiling 中 Cube、Vector、MTE2 的时间占比。如果 Cube 等待 Vector，考虑减少 "
-"Vector 后处理粒度或打开 CV balance 相关选项；如果 Vector 等待搬运，优先检查离散访存、tail-axis padding 和 "
-"multibuffer 配置。"
-msgstr ""
-"When tuning complex CV fusion, first observe the time proportions of Cube, "
-"Vector, and MTE2 in profiling. If Cube is waiting for Vector, consider "
-"reducing the Vector post-processing granularity or enabling CV balance-"
-"related options; if Vector is waiting for data movement, prioritize checking"
-" scattered memory access, tail-axis padding, and multibuffer configurations."
-
-msgid ""
-"# 在 matmul kernel 内部，K 循环完成后得到 fp32 accumulator。\n"
-"acc = tl.dot(a, b, acc)  # 通常位于 K 维循环内，这里仅展示结构。\n"
-"\n"
-"# 在写回前融合轻量 Vector 后处理。\n"
-"acc = tl.where(acc >= 0, acc, 0.01 * acc)\n"
-"c = acc.to(tl.float16)\n"
-"\n"
-"offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)\n"
-"offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)\n"
-"c_ptrs = c_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_cm + offs_n[None, :] * stride_cn\n"
-"c_mask = (offs_m[:, None] < M) & (offs_n[None, :] < N)\n"
-"tl.store(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)\n"
-msgstr ""
-"# Inside the matmul kernel, the fp32 accumulator is obtained after the K loop completes.\n"
-"acc = tl.dot(a, b, acc)  # Usually located inside the K-dimension loop; shown here for structure only.\n"
-"\n"
-"# Fuse a lightweight Vector post-processing step before writing back.\n"
-"acc = tl.where(acc >= 0, acc, 0.01 * acc)\n"
-"c = acc.to(tl.float16)\n"
-"\n"
-"offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)\n"
-"offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)\n"
-"c_ptrs = c_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_cm + offs_n[None, :] * stride_cn\n"
-"c_mask = (offs_m[:, None] < M) & (offs_n[None, :] < N)\n"
-"tl.store(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)\n"

-msgid "单核运算的关键点" -msgstr "Key points of single-core computation" - -msgid "-块级数据处理：每个计算块负责一小段数据，保证并行性。" -msgstr "" -"- Block-level data processing: Each compute block processes a small segment " -"of data to ensure parallelism." - -msgid "-边界检查：使用 mask 或 if (tid < N) 避免越界。" -msgstr "" -"-Bounds checking: Use a mask or if (tid < N) to avoid out-of-bounds access." - -msgid "-块大小选择：合理设置 block 和 grid" -msgstr "-Block size selection: Set the block and grid appropriately." - -msgid "性能要点：" -msgstr "Performance key points:" - -msgid "" -"(1)访存优化 -保证连续访问。 -使用对齐的 stride，避免跨行/跨列跳跃式访问。 -尽量让数据块大小对齐到 32 字节边界。 输入输出 " -"buffer 在分配时保证对齐，避免访存性能下降。 例：" -msgstr "" -"(1) Memory access optimization - Ensure contiguous access. - Use aligned " -"strides to avoid jumping access across rows or columns. - Align data block " -"sizes to the 32-byte boundary as much as possible. Ensure that input and " -"output buffers are aligned during allocation to prevent memory access " -"performance degradation. Example:" - -msgid "" -"BLOCK_SIZE = 256 # 256 * 4 Byte = 1024 Byte，对齐良好\n" -"\n" -"@triton.jit\n" -"def vec_add_kernel(X, Y, Z, N,\n" -" BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):\n" -" pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)\n" -"\n" -" # 计算当前 block 负责的 index 范围\n" -" offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)\n" -"\n" -" # mask 防止越界\n" -" mask = offsets < N\n" -"\n" -" # 连续访存：offsets 是连续的\n" -" x = tl.load(X + offsets, mask=mask)\n" -" y = tl.load(Y + offsets, mask=mask)\n" -"\n" -" z = x + y\n" -"\n" -" # 连续写回\n" -" tl.store(Z + offsets, z, mask=mask)\n" -"\n" -"\n" -"def vec_add(x, y):\n" -" assert x.numel() == y.numel()\n" -" N = x.numel()\n" -"\n" -" # 分配对齐内存（PyTorch 默认已经对齐到 64 字节）\n" -" z = torch.empty_like(x)\n" -"\n" -" # grid：每个 block 处理 BLOCK_SIZE 个元素\n" -" grid = lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(N, meta['BLOCK_SIZE']),)\n" -"\n" -" vec_add_kernel[grid](x, y, z, N, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)\n" -"\n" -" return z\n" -msgstr "" -"BLOCK_SIZE = 256 # 256 * 4 Byte = 1024 Byte, well aligned\n" -"\n" -"@triton.jit\n" -"def vec_add_kernel(X, Y, Z, N,\n" -" BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):\n" -" pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)\n" -"\n" -" # Calculate the index range handled by the current block\n" -" offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)\n" -"\n" -" # Mask to prevent out-of-bounds access\n" -" mask = offsets < N\n" -"\n" -" # Contiguous memory access: offsets are contiguous\n" -" x = tl.load(X + offsets, mask=mask)\n" -" y = tl.load(Y + offsets, mask=mask)\n" -"\n" -" z = x + y\n" -"\n" -" # Write back contiguously\n" -" tl.store(Z + offsets, z, mask=mask)\n" -"\n" -"\n" -"def vec_add(x, y):\n" -" assert x.numel() == y.numel()\n" -" N = x.numel()\n" -"\n" -" # Allocate aligned memory (PyTorch is aligned to 64 bytes by default)\n" -" z = torch.empty_like(x)\n" -"\n" -" # Grid: each block processes BLOCK_SIZE elements\n" -" grid = lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(N, meta['BLOCK_SIZE']),)\n" -"\n" -" vec_add_kernel[grid](x, y, z, N, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)\n" -"\n" -" return z\n" - -msgid "Vector 算子开发"
-msgstr "Vector operator development"
-
-msgid ""
-"Vector 算子主要由 Vector Core 执行，典型形态包括逐元素计算、行级归约、类型转换、Gather/Scatter、Mask 更新以及不含"
-" `tl.dot` 的小型融合算子。开发重点不是把 grid 切得越细越好，而是在固定物理 Vector Core 数量的前提下，让每个 program"
-" 在核内循环处理多个 tile。"
-msgstr ""
-"Vector operators are primarily executed by the Vector Core, with typical "
-"forms including element-wise computation, row-level reduction, type "
-"conversion, Gather/Scatter, Mask updates, and small fused operators that do "
-"not contain `tl.dot`. The development focus is not on making the grid as "
-"fine-grained as possible, but rather, under the premise of a fixed number of"
-" physical Vector Cores, allowing each program to process multiple tiles in a"
-" loop within the core."
-
-msgid "Vector 简单算子开发"
-msgstr "Simple operator development for Vector."
-
-msgid ""
-"简单 Vector 算子可以从本仓的 [向量相加样例](../examples/01_vector_add_example.md) 或 "
-"`third_party/ascend/tutorials/01-vector-add.py` 入手。该类算子的基本步骤如下："
-msgstr ""
-"You can start with the simple Vector operator from the [vector addition "
-"example](../examples/01_vector_add_example.md) in this repository or "
-"`third_party/ascend/tutorials/01-vector-add.py`. The basic steps for this "
-"type of operator are as follows:"
-
-msgid "用 `tl.arange` 构造当前 tile 的连续偏移。"
-msgstr ""
-"Construct the contiguous offsets of the current tile using `tl.arange`."
-
-msgid "用 `mask` 保护尾块，避免越界 load/store。"
-msgstr ""
-"Use `mask` to protect the tail block, avoiding out-of-bounds load/store."
-
-msgid "完成逐元素计算后写回结果。"
-msgstr "After completing the element-wise computation, write back the result."
-
-msgid ""
-"当 grid 数远大于物理核数时，将 grid 固定为 `num_vectorcore`，在 kernel 内用 `range(pid, "
-"num_blocks, num_core)` 分批处理。"
-msgstr ""
-"When the grid count is much larger than the number of physical cores, fix "
-"the grid to `num_vectorcore` and process in batches within the kernel using "
-"`range(pid, num_blocks, num_core)`."
-
-msgid "基础 kernel 结构如下："
-msgstr "The basic kernel structure is as follows:"
-
-msgid ""
-"@triton.jit\n"
-"def add_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, out_ptr, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):\n"
-"    pid = tl.program_id(0)\n"
-"    num_core = tl.num_programs(0)\n"
-"    num_blocks = tl.cdiv(n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE)\n"
-"\n"
-"    for block_idx in range(pid, num_blocks, num_core):\n"
-"        offsets = block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)\n"
-"        mask = offsets < n_elements\n"
-"        x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask)\n"
-"        y = tl.load(y_ptr + offsets, mask=mask)\n"
-"        tl.store(out_ptr + offsets, x + y, mask=mask)\n"
-msgstr ""
-"@triton.jit\n"
-"def add_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, out_ptr, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):\n"
-"    pid = tl.program_id(0)\n"
-"    num_core = tl.num_programs(0)\n"
-"    num_blocks = tl.cdiv(n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE)\n"
-"\n"
-"    for block_idx in range(pid, num_blocks, num_core):\n"
-"        offsets = block_idx * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)\n"
-"        mask = offsets < n_elements\n"
-"        x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask)\n"
-"        y = tl.load(y_ptr + offsets, mask=mask)\n"
-"        tl.store(out_ptr + offsets, x + y, mask=mask)\n"
-
-msgid "开发时优先检查三类问题："
-msgstr "When developing, prioritize checking three types of issues:"
-
-msgid ""
-"**数据类型**：Ascend Vector 单元对不同整数类型的支持和性能不同。对于不影响精度的索引、长度、偏移类数据，优先使用 "
-"`int32`，可参考 `triton-ascend-ops/tutorial/basic/001-vector_add.zh.md` 和 "
-"`002-vector_cmp.zh.md`。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Data Types**: Ascend Vector units have different support and performance "
-"for different integer types. For index, length, and offset data that do not "
-"affect precision, prefer using `int32`. Refer to `triton-ascend-"
-"ops/tutorial/basic/001-vector_add.zh.md` and `002-vector_cmp.zh.md`."
-
-msgid ""
-"**BLOCK_SIZE**：BLOCK_SIZE 需要在 UB 容量内尽量大。若出现 UB overflow，先降低单次处理元素数，再考虑拆分子块。"
-msgstr ""
-"**BLOCK_SIZE**: BLOCK_SIZE should be as large as possible within the UB "
-"capacity. If UB overflow occurs, first reduce the number of elements "
-"processed per-iteration, then consider splitting into sub-blocks."
-
-msgid ""
-"**分核数**：NPU 物理 Vector Core 数量通常为几十个。小 tile 大 grid 的 GPU 写法迁移到 NPU "
-"时，容易因多轮下发带来明显开销。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Number of cores**: The number of physical Vector Cores on an NPU is "
-"typically in the dozens. When migrating GPU code written with small tiles "
-"and large grids to an NPU, multiple rounds of dispatch can easily introduce "
-"significant overhead."
-
-msgid "Vector 复杂算子开发"
-msgstr "Development of Complex Operators for Vector"
-
-msgid ""
-"复杂 Vector 算子通常不是单个逐元素表达式，而是带有离散访存、批量重排、多个输出或长 hidden size 的组合逻辑。可参考 "
-"[Ascend/triton-ascend-ops](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops) "
-"中的以下案例："
-msgstr ""
-"Complex Vector operators are typically not single element-wise expressions, "
-"but rather combined logic involving discrete memory access, batch "
-"rearrangement, multiple outputs, or long hidden sizes. Refer to the "
-"following examples in [Ascend/triton-ascend-"
-"ops](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-ascend-ops):"
-
-msgid ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/004-gather_scatter.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"

-msgstr ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/004-gather_scatter.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/004-gather_scatter.py): Ascend-"
-"friendly implementation of Megablocks gather/scatter/scatter_wgrad."
-
-msgid ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/005-binned_gather_scatter.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/005-binned_gather_scatter.py)：按 "
-"expert/bin 分组后的 gather/scatter。"
-msgstr ""

-"ascend-ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/005-binned_gather_scatter.py): "
-"gather/scatter after grouping by expert/bin."
-
-msgid ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/006-padded_gather_scatter.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/006-padded_gather_scatter.py)：带 "
-"padding 的 MoE gather/scatter。"
-msgstr ""
-"[`tutorial/best_practice/006-padded_gather_scatter.py`](https://github.com/Ascend/triton-"
-"ascend-ops/blob/main/tutorial/best_practice/006-padded_gather_scatter.py): "
-"MoE gather/scatter with padding."
-
-msgid "这类算子的组织方式通常是："
-msgstr "These operators are typically organized as follows:"
-
-msgid ""
-"**按物理核切分外层任务**：用 `num_vectorcore` 作为 grid，每个 program 负责一段 indices 或 token。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Split outer tasks by physical cores**: Use `num_vectorcore` as the grid, "
-"with each program responsible for a segment of indices or tokens."
-
-msgid ""
-"**按 UB 容量切分 hidden 维**：对 `NUM_COLUMNS` 使用 `BLOCK_X` 分块，并预留 double "
-"buffer、索引和临时张量的空间。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Split hidden dimension by UB capacity**: Use `BLOCK_X` to block "
-"`NUM_COLUMNS`, and reserve space for double buffers, indices, and temporary "
-"tensors."
-
-msgid ""
-"**用 `SUB_BLOCK_SIZE` 合并小粒度离散任务**：一次加载一组 indices，在 UB 中组织成连续临时块，减少 GM 标量访存和多次"
-" store。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Merge small-granularity discrete tasks with `SUB_BLOCK_SIZE`**: Load a "
-"group of indices at a time, organize them into contiguous temporary blocks "
-"in UB, reducing GM scalar memory access and multiple stores."
-
-msgid ""
-"**用扩展语义管理 UB 内局部数据**：先通过 `import triton.language.extra.cann.extension as "
-"extension` 引入扩展模块，再使用 `extension.insert_slice` 合并多行数据，使用 "
-"`extension.extract_slice` 取出子块后再分散写回。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Managing Local Data in UB with Extended Semantics**: First, import the "
-"extension module via `import triton.language.extra.cann.extension as "
-"extension`, then use `extension.insert_slice` to merge multiple rows of "
-"data, and use `extension.extract_slice` to extract sub-blocks before "
-"scattering writes back."
-
-msgid ""
-"**为尾块保留统一 mask**：复杂 gather/scatter 中同时存在 index mask、column mask 和 expert/bin"
-" 边界，建议分别命名并只在 load/store 处组合。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Reserve a unified mask for the tail block**: In complex gather/scatter "
-"operations where index masks, column masks, and expert/bin boundaries "
-"coexist, it is recommended to name them separately and combine them only at "
-"load/store points."
-
-msgid "典型的 UB 预算思路如下："
-msgstr "A typical UB budgeting approach is as follows:"
-
-msgid ""
-"num_core = get_npu_properties()[\"num_vectorcore\"]\n"
-"block_size = triton.cdiv(indices_length, num_core)\n"
-"align_elems = 16\n"
-"block_x = triton.cdiv(min(num_columns, max_block_x), align_elems) * align_elems\n"
-"sub_block_size = max((ub_budget - block_x * element_bytes) //\n"
-"                     (block_x * element_bytes + index_bytes), 1)\n"
-msgstr ""
-"num_core = get_npu_properties()[\"num_vectorcore\"]\n"
-"block_size = triton.cdiv(indices_length, num_core)\n"
-"align_elems = 16\n"
-"block_x = triton.cdiv(min(num_columns, max_block_x), align_elems) * align_elems\n"
-"sub_block_size = max((ub_budget - block_x * element_bytes) //\n"
-"                     (block_x * element_bytes + index_bytes), 1)\n"
-
-msgid "当复杂 Vector 算子性能不达预期时，优先从以下方向排查："
-msgstr ""
-"When the performance of a complex Vector operator does not meet "
-"expectations, prioritize troubleshooting from the following directions:"
-
-msgid "grid 是否远大于物理 Vector Core 数，导致多轮下发。"
-msgstr ""
-"Whether the grid is much larger than the number of physical Vector Cores, "
-"causing multiple rounds of dispatch."
-
-msgid "离散访存是否可转化为“批量搬入 UB 后在 UB 内选择”。"
-msgstr ""
-"Can discrete memory access be transformed into \"batch loading into UB "
-"followed by selection within UB\"?"
-
-msgid "尾轴（最后一个维度）是否满足 32B 对齐；不满足时是否可用转置或借轴转置规避自动 padding。"
-msgstr ""
-"Whether the tail axis (the last dimension) satisfies 32B alignment; if not, "
-"whether transposition or axis-borrowing transposition can be used to avoid "
-"automatic padding."
-
-msgid "`BLOCK_X` 和 `SUB_BLOCK_SIZE` 是否造成 UB overflow 或过小的搬运粒度。"
-msgstr ""
-"Whether `BLOCK_X` and `SUB_BLOCK_SIZE` cause UB overflow or an excessively "
-"small transfer granularity."

-#: ../../zh/quick_start.md:5
-msgid ""
-"**Triton-"
-"Ascend**是适配华为Ascend处理器的Triton优化版本，用于高效进行核函数自动调优、算子编译及部署，通过兼容Triton核心语法并针对昇腾NPU特性进行深度优化，能够帮助用户在昇腾平台上快速开发和部署高性能计算任务。"
-msgstr ""
-"**Triton-Ascend** is an optimized version of Triton adapted for Huawei "
-"Ascend processors, used for efficient kernel auto-tuning, operator "
-"compilation, and deployment. By being compatible with Triton core syntax and"
-" performing deep optimization for Ascend NPU features, it helps users "
-"quickly develop and deploy high-performance computing tasks on the Ascend "
-"Platform."

-#: ../../zh/quick_start.md:7
-msgid ""
-"本文以**Ubuntu 22.04**环境下通过软件包部署方式在线安装并运行向量加法示例为例，指导用户快速上手使用**Triton-"
-"Ascend**。如需体验更多安装方式请阅读[安装指南](./installation_guide.md)文档。"
-msgstr ""

-"installing and running the vector addition sample online through software "
-"package deployment in an **Ubuntu 22.04** environment. For more installation"
-" methods, refer to the [Installation Guide](./installation_guide.md) "
-"document."
